groupBlurb.en: Affirmate Group provides cross-border support in Indonesia, facilitating investment, real estate, and administrative services. We connect businesses and investors, offering advisory, coordination, and market entry support to help clients successfully establish and grow their presence in Indonesia.
groupBlurb.id: Affirmate Group memberikan dukungan lintas negara di Indonesia, memfasilitasi investasi, properti, dan layanan administrasi. Kami menghubungkan pelaku usaha dan investor melalui advisory, koordinasi, serta dukungan masuk pasar agar klien dapat membangun dan mengembangkan kehadirannya di Indonesia.

description.en: A dedicated unit of Affirmate Group providing company incorporation, licensing, visa and work permit, HR and payroll administration, compliance, relocation and back-office support in Indonesia.
